title: Bringing routines in from a Hevy link depends on Hevy's web page, and nobody is told when Hevy changes it
what: The Hevy link import works by opening Hevy's public share page in a hidden browser and reading the routines off the screen. If Hevy changes how that page looks, every member who pastes a link is told 'We found no routines on that page. Check that it is a Hevy folder or routine link', which blames the member's link. No scheduled check opens a real Hevy link, and a failed read is only noted on the member's own phone, so the owner first hears of it from members, if at all.
expected: A small scheduled cloud check that reads one known Hevy share link and warns the owner when it finds no routines, and a member message that says the reader may be out of date rather than that the link is wrong.
who: members moving from Hevy, and the owner
how_often: every time Hevy changes its share page
fix_line: Add a daily cloud check on one real Hevy link that alerts the owner, and soften the member message

items.reason: no contact-us, support, email or WhatsApp path in these components; the help conversation lives in another area
